note: Combat items that aren't worn (gear is equipment.json): kind material (whetstones, fragments, Repair Kits; stack 999), potion (HP/MP Potions; stack 99, `heals` hp or mp by their tier's number in classes/stats.json potions), agimat (`stat`: its stat; the item's level and slot lock are the item's own; stack 999 with the same stat, level and lock), cosmetic (doesn't stack). rarity: its name's colour (stats.json rarity). tier: stats.json gearTiers / potions.tiers (low…). icon 16x16, showcase 32x32, large 64x64. shop: sold at the sari-sari store, priced by stats.json (potion: potions.tiers[tier].kusing in Kusing, the Healing tab; whetstone / repairKit: currencies.kowensShop in Kowens, the Smithing tab). forge: what it does at the forge popup, for its tier's gear (whetstone: enhances; fragment: ten combine into its tier's whetstone; repairKit: repairs a broken item). consumable: used somewhere in the world, not from the bag (the Warren Ticket: at the Warren Gate; stack 99; shop ticket = the Dungeons tab, priced in classes/dungeons.json warrens.ticket.sources.shop).

items.name: Rough Whetstone
items.about: Enhances weapons, armor and accessories of item Lv 1-20 (the Low tier).

items.name: Rough Whetstone Fragment
items.about: Ten make a Rough Whetstone. From taking gear apart.

items.name: Low Repair Kit
items.about: Repairs a broken item of item Lv 1-20 (the Low tier).

items.name: Agimat Pliers
items.about: Pulls one agimat out of a weapon or armor piece without breaking it.
items.note: repo-only: the forge's Remove mode; price a placeholder (the sari-sari store's Smithing tab)

items.name: Temper Stone
items.about: Draws an item's + into the stone, to put onto another item of the same type and item level.
items.note: repo-only: an empty Temper Stone (the forge's Draw mode); price a placeholder (the Smithing tab)

items.name: Temper Stone
items.about: Holds a +: put it onto an item of the same type and item level with a lower +. That item's own + is lost.
items.note: repo-only: a filled Temper Stone (the forge's Apply mode): the item's plus is the + it holds, its level the item level, its lock the type (an equipment slot); bound if the item it came from was; never stacks
